items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records two properties of the derived tensor product constructed in the preceding text: that the construction is independent of choices and defines an exact functor of triangulated categories, and that it satisfies a functorial base-change isomorphism. The proof is an application of the general machinery of right derived functors: the author sets up the homotopy category and the derived category, names the exact functor given by taking the total tensor product, checks the two hypotheses of the existence lemma for the class of K-flat complexes, and concludes that the derived functor is everywhere defined and computed by K-flat resolutions. The final isomorphism is then verified by computing both sides on a K-flat representative, using that base change of a K-flat complex is again K-flat and that the two total complex constructions agree.
